name: lumapress-monorepo
description: LumaPress - Production-Ready Full-Stack Editorial Blogging Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.deploy: npm run build:client && cp client/dist/index.html client/dist/404.html && gh-pages -d client/dist
